title: Card Rarity Progression in my NBA Drafting game
author: CanAdept7703
selftext:
Player Card PRogression in my NBA drafting game.  
Do the colors make sense? what would you change to the template?

comments.author: Pizzaman2948
comments.body: I think they should be consistent, the bottom right one is different and i cant tell why.

replies.author: CanAdept7703
replies.body: it's like the top tier, F,E,D,V,B,A,S,SS,SSS and SSS get also a number which is a rank in my grding system.

replies.author: New-Part-6917
replies.body:
agreed. OP it looks great but it's missing something to make it all sync up. For starters the S tiers have square borders, feel like that's unnecessary.

I think the other issue is the colour borders are just too much. You've got twenty zillion colours going on rather than just a gradient. B and SS almost have the same borders. D and C start well then it goes purple, gold, red, back to pink/purple, then rainbows. 

Again, I like what you've got going on - too much at once though. Choose a couple of identifiers and make a natural progression up the tiers. SS1 can stay as a unique type because the grading changes to numerical.

Maybe look into a foil shader?

comments.author: hwantasticgames
comments.body:
I love sports games! Developing a sports game is in my wishlist. Great Job!  
Maybe it looks like the feeling that other people told me that my game has the AI art style. I can't describe it but now I can feel. Personally, I don't think it's a matter. Only the fun matters.   
I think SSS's color palette should not changed. It's too confusing. And I think purple is generally used for powerful rank.

comments.author: allpotatoes247
comments.body: this is a good idea, i was thinking something simlar, like a sports manager game, nfl or nascar etc
